# Freire Press & GrowthBook Kick Off
Date: 2026-11-11 | Duration: 39.84000015258789m

## Summary
The team adopted a six-week GrowthBook onboarding package covering SDK connections, data setup, hands-on implementation support, integration verification, and first experiments. Implementation begins near zero: documentation was reviewed, but no proof of concept exists, and current A/B testing and feature flagging are handled by separate homegrown tools. The website is the initial priority, using a PHP server-rendered architecture with JavaScript additions; the hybrid mobile app and other web properties are future scope. GrowthBook will use SDKs, CDN-delivered JSON configuration, Google Tag Manager, Piano Analytics, and Databricks for exposure and metric analysis. The first integration gate is an A/A test, requiring accurate user, experiment, variation, timestamp, and analysis attributes. Tom Kühne will refine the Databricks event model, while the customer team will select initial metrics and attributes. Microsoft Teams coordination, presentation slides, and implementation support are immediate deliverables.

## Keywords
GrowthBook SDK, Databricks, A/B testing, Feature flags, Experiment tracking, Microsoft Teams
